Ornaments are NOT INCLUDED and are used just for effect.
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This holiday season, spend more time celebrating and less time maintaining and cleaning up with this Tall Pre-lit, Artificial Christmas Tree from HOMCOM. With this particular model, built in LED light that complement each other in a beautiful sparkling display to give off an authentic holiday feel. Each LED light create a striking lighting display that really makes this tree the centerpiece of the holiday. Artificial Christmas tree in a realistic tree style. Warm white LED lighting built right into the tree provides a dazzlingly display. Beautiful pre-set light patterns, 8 different light sequences automatic play when power on for creative holiday twinkling. Controller included. Realistic plastic branches give a full and lush look to the tree. Base is detachable and foldable for easy storage. Sturdy and durable base for better stability. Branches are flame retardant, to ensure secured. Tree Color: Green. Light Color: Warm white. Material: PVC, Steel. Overall Dimension: 4FT: F74 x 120H cm. 5FT: F84 x 150H cm. 6FT: F94 x 180H cm. Branch Tips: 4FT: 322. 5FT: 502. 6FT: 714. LED Light Count: 4FT: 200. 5FT: 150. 6FT: 200. Power Cord Line Length: 5 m. Input: 220-240V/50Hz. Output: 31V/3.2-4W. Note: Only for indoor use, not for outdoor. In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree, suggest you to take 25-35 minutes to shape the tree. Only the tree with the stand is included. Ornaments are NOT INCLUDED and are used just for effect. UK Mainland Delivery Only.
